content: Stagehand v3 (Browserbase) is an AI-native browser automation SDK combining natural-language actions with code precision, CDP-based for speed, works with Playwright/Puppeteer, ~500k weekly downloads for v2, now has a REST API usable directly from Claude Code. It's a viable alternative if the agent needed a standalone natural-language browser-control library outside MCP, but since Claude Code already natively speaks MCP and Playwright MCP is Microsoft's first-party server, adding Stagehand would be a redundant extra dependency/runtime for this project's needs.
